metadata.name: slana
metadata.description: Slana: cute coin-themed on-chain Agar.io (identity, stakes, seasons, prizes)

accounts.name: next_season
docs: Season `config.current_season + 1`.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the config and season 1. Only the program's upgrade authority may call it.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority (prevents front-running `initialize`).

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's ProgramData account (PDA of the upgradeable loader, seeds `[program_id]`).

accounts.name: session
docs: One open session per player per arena: a second join fails because the PDA exists.

instructions.name: record_game
docs: Server-signed free-play result.

accounts.name: current_season
docs: `dup` so that `season_id == current_season` is reported as `InvalidSeason` by the
constraint above instead of a generic duplicate-account error.

instructions.name: settle_session
docs: Server-signed cash-out of a stake session.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not authorized for this action

errors.name: InvalidName
errors.msg: Name must be 1-16 bytes of UTF-8 without control characters

errors.name: InvalidMaxPlayers
errors.msg: Max players must be between 2 and 100

errors.name: NotEligible
errors.msg: Not eligible for a season reward

errors.name: SessionMismatch
errors.msg: Settlement is for a different session

types.name: Arena
docs: A stake arena tier. PDA `["arena", id.to_le_bytes()]`.
The arena account itself is the vault: every lamport above its rent-exempt
minimum belongs to the pot.

types.name: Config
docs: Global configuration. PDA `["config"]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: May change the configuration, create arenas and manage seasons.

fields.name: server_authority
docs: Game server key that signs `settle_session` and `record_game`.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives skin purchases, the treasury part of fees and swept arena leftovers.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Fee charged on stake profit, in basis points (≤ `MAX_FEE_BPS`).

fields.name: season_share_bps
docs: Part of the fee that goes to the current season prize pool, in basis points.

fields.name: skin_price
docs: Price of a premium skin in lamports.

fields.name: current_season
docs: Id of the season that is currently running.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new arena joins (settlements and refunds keep working).

types.name: LeaderEntry
docs: One row of a season leaderboard.

fields.name: best_score
docs: Best single-game score of this player during the season.

types.name: PlayerProfile
docs: On-chain player identity and statistics. PDA `["profile", owner]`.

fields.name: name
docs: UTF-8 name bytes, zero padded; only `name[..name_len]` is meaningful.

fields.name: skin
docs: Equipped skin id.

fields.name: premium_skins
docs: Owned premium skins: bit `i` set ⇔ skin `PREMIUM_SKIN_START + i` owned.

fields.name: season
docs: Season that `season_points` belongs to.

types.name: Season
docs: A season with its top-20 leaderboard. PDA `["season", id.to_le_bytes()]`.
Every lamport above the rent-exempt minimum is prize money.

fields.name: prize_pool
docs: Prize pool frozen by `end_season`.

fields.name: claimed_mask
docs: Bit `rank` set ⇔ the prize of that rank was claimed.

fields.name: count
docs: Number of used leaderboard entries.

fields.name: entries
docs: Sorted by `points`, descending; only `entries[..count]` are meaningful.

types.name: Session
docs: An open stake session (one per player per arena). PDA `["session", arena, player]`.

fields.name: session_id
docs: `Session::id` the server is settling. Session PDAs are reused when a player joins
the same arena again, so this stops a delayed/retried settlement of an old session
from being applied to a newer one at the same address.

fields.name: payout
docs: Lamports the player cashed out with (taken from the arena pot).

types.name: UpdateConfigArgs
docs: Every `Some` field replaces the stored value; `None` keeps it.

constants.name: ARENA_SEED
docs: `Arena` PDA: `["arena", id.to_le_bytes() (u16)]`.

constants.name: BPS
docs: Basis-point denominator (100 %).

constants.name: CLAIM_WINDOW_SECS
docs: Season prizes can be claimed for this many seconds after the season ended (30 days).

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: `Config` PDA: `["config"]`.

constants.name: FIRST_SEASON
docs: Id of the first season (created by `initialize`).

constants.name: FREE_SKINS
docs: Skins `0..FREE_SKINS` are free.

constants.name: LEADERBOARD_SIZE
docs: Number of entries kept on each season leaderboard.

constants.name: LEVEL_SKIN_REQUIREMENTS
docs: Level required by level-gated skins (skin 8 needs level 2 … skin 15 needs level 20).

constants.name: LEVEL_SKIN_START
docs: Skins `LEVEL_SKIN_START..PREMIUM_SKIN_START` are unlocked by level.

constants.name: MAX_ARENA_PLAYERS
docs: Maximum value of `Arena::max_players`.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_BPS
docs: Upper bound for `Config::fee_bps` (10 %).

constants.name: MAX_NAME_LEN
docs: Maximum player name length in bytes (UTF-8).

constants.name: MAX_SCORE_PER_GAME
docs: Score of a single game is clamped to this value.

constants.name: MAX_XP_PER_GAME
docs: XP granted by a single game is clamped to this value.

constants.name: MIN_ARENA_PLAYERS
docs: Minimum value of `Arena::max_players`.

constants.name: MIN_BUY_IN
docs: Minimum arena buy-in (0.001 SOL).

constants.name: PREMIUM_SKIN_START
docs: Skins `PREMIUM_SKIN_START..SKIN_COUNT` are bought with SOL (bit `skin - 16` of `premium_skins`).

constants.name: PRIZE_RANKS
docs: Number of leaderboard ranks that receive a season prize.

constants.name: PRIZE_SHARES_BPS
docs: Prize share of each season rank in basis points (sums to 10 000).

constants.name: PROFILE_SEED
docs: `PlayerProfile` PDA: `["profile", owner]`.

constants.name: SEASON_SEED
docs: `Season` PDA: `["season", id.to_le_bytes() (u32)]`.

constants.name: SESSION_REFUND_TIMEOUT_SECS
docs: A session that was never settled can be refunded by its player after this many seconds (24 h).

constants.name: SESSION_SEED
docs: `Session` PDA: `["session", arena, player]`.

constants.name: SKIN_COUNT
docs: Total number of skins (ids `0..SKIN_COUNT`).

constants.name: XP_LEVEL_DIVISOR
docs: `level = 1 + isqrt(xp / XP_LEVEL_DIVISOR)`.
